verdict.rationale: Mercury provides event infrastructure: webhooks give real-time notifications for transaction and balance changes, and an events endpoint exposes them. Users can build event-triggered automations on top of these with their own code via the API, CLI, or MCP. Native rules are limited to specific cases: a long-time customer reports auto-funding rules across accounts, and approval policies gate payment requests, but there is no documented general-purpose, user-defined rule engine that runs actions automatically. Missing for 10: a native configurable event→action rules builder, documentation of auto-funding/rule configuration, and evidence of no-code automation triggers.
